name: chophper
description: Field formatters that truncate formatted-text fields while preserving HTML structure, using the Chophper PHP library.
project_description: Chophper provides two field formatters for truncating formatted (rich-text) fields using the code-atlantic/chophper PHP library, which parses the HTML with a real DOM/HTML5 parser and truncates it while keeping tags balanced. 'Trimmed (Chophper)' behaves like core's Trimmed formatter but truncates by words, characters, sentences or blocks with a configurable ellipsis and optional word preservation, and works on text, text_long and text_with_summary fields. 'Summary or trimmed (Chophper)' renders the field's manual summary when present and otherwise falls back to Chophper truncation, for text_with_summary fields. The formatters are presentation-only, configured on each entity view display; the module adds no routes, permissions, services or config objects of its own.
